value: Verify that the distributable generated payment page can recover the same beneficiary and settle an already funded obligation after the original app is unavailable, including reconciliation after a lost response.
implementationScope: Test-only integration and bounded disposable harness chain-ID option; generated production main, renderer, helper, SDK exports, guards, journals and contracts unchanged.

reproduction: Download the anonymous GitHub archive for the exact sourceCommit, enter account-reserve with Node24+ and an installed local Anvil/Forge.

The full replay runs 85 top-level tests: the new survival case, five disposable-chain cases, and the 79 previously selected starter/helper/public SDK/source-package cases. Nested and repeated runs are not added.
checkedBoundaries: Fresh installed generated consumer; production entry/helper bytes match source and compiled assets remain byte-identical.
Installed public reserve SDK prepares an authenticated encrypted record. The runtime uses its unchanged default native WebAuthn adapter and same-origin read-only HTTP store.
The original signing session is ended and A returns503 before B loads; no request to A during recovery, claim or reconciliation.
Startup reads configuration only: no RPC, credential, reserve access, journal read/write or lock. Availability reads do not authenticate or access persistence.
One deliberate existing-reserve action invokes the credential API synchronously from the click. No credential creation or store write.
The signed transaction hash is durably journaled before one unchanged raw transaction is sent; its response is dropped only after actual local EVM acceptance.
Changing selection cannot trigger another authentication or send while uncertainty remains. The actual recovered Mera signer rejects signing with SESSION_ENDED.
A fresh process receives only the public journal/profile and reconciles through the generated page after local finality, with no credential material, reserve read or broadcast.
Exact claim calldata, transaction chain/nonce/value, beneficiary/amount/event, finalized receipt, gas-adjusted beneficiary balance, claimed state and contract balance are checked.
Encrypted reserve bytes, origin/config/protocol binding and production asset digests remain unchanged. Owned servers, worker processes and Anvil are closed.

internalReview.scope: Internal agent review, not an external security audit.
clarifications: Source ESM main/page execute under Node/JSDOM; compiled bundle is built and hashed, not executed in a physical browser.
Test-only CSS loader and transparent helper-session observer live outside production assets and preserve the exact SDK/native recovery object.
The alternate selected right is unissued; funded-next-payment uncertainty blocking is covered by the existing helper suite, not independently by this one local-chain case.
